During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''village''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karra]] was visited by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Elth Nardah]] and a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents. They hoped to broker a treaty with the native [[Karran]]s, led by [[Tist]]. However, after a misunderstanding occurred when the team captured the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Darryn Edalm]], the Karran proceeded saw the Alliance team as a threat and tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] them.
